news.author: @Moizefala
news.title: ❤ Welcome to Sillet
news.description: Hey everyone! Thanks for giving Sillet a try. Your private keys stay right on your device, so you remain in control of your wallet. Just head over to Receive, choose your coin and network, and you're ready to go! We really but really appreciate having you here. Stay safe and enjoy our wallet :)

news.author: @Moizefala
news.title: ✿ How Sillet keeps you safe
news.description: Sillet has no accounts, no tracking and no servers of our own, so we never see your keys, balances or activity. Your wallet is encrypted with AES-256 and a strong password key, locked to your computer so a stolen copy is useless, and protected from clipboard hijackers, screenshots and apps trying to read its memory. And soon Sillet will be open source, so anyone can check the code for themselves. Thanks for trusting us, we attached a link to our page with safety tutorials

news.author: @Moizefala
news.title: ✸ Release
news.description: Sillet has been released to the public. Thank you very much for your support and messages. Remember to join the community clicking the attached link

news.author: @Moizefala
news.title: ❖ More privacy in your hands
news.description: Sillet 1.1.2 brings new ways to protect your privacy. Turn on rotating receive addresses in Settings and Bitcoin, Litecoin and Dogecoin give you a fresh address after every payment, while your old ones keep working. Change from your sends also goes to new addresses of your wallet now. You can route Sillet through a SOCKS5 proxy or Tor, or point any network to a node you run yourself. We also merged our guides into one page, with how Sillet protects you, which services it talks to, the roadmap and the known issues. Read it with the attached link

news.author: @Moizefala
news.title: ✦ Sillet 1.1.2
news.description: Sillet 1.1.2 is out and it is a big one. Sillet now speaks French, you get a notice when a new version is out, and on Windows it can install updates by itself with a simple switch in Settings. You can have several accounts per network, add an optional BIP-39 passphrase, and add your own tokens by contract address. Incoming payments now show the transaction id and who sent it, and Linea, Blast and Gnosis join the supported networks. On phones, pages and scrolling feel smoother and news swipe sideways. Activity can be filtered by sent and received, and Settings is tidier, with a little info icon whenever there is more to read. Thanks to sami for reviewing the French translations (@Moilalamoi). Download the new version with the attached link

news.author: @Moizefala
news.title: ✧ Sillet 1.1.3
news.description: Sillet 1.1.3 is here. Chainlink (LINK), Worldcoin, FDUSD and TRUMP join the coins, and XRP prices are in. Payments now show Pending, Confirmed and Sent with checks, and received payments tell you their status in notifications. When you send to an address for the first time, the review screen lets you know. Settings has a search bar, currencies come with flags, and on phones changing tabs feels a lot faster. Max in Trade now leaves room for the network fee. Developer mode is hidden at the bottom of Settings if you want to try fake payments. Download the new version with the attached link

news.author: @Moizefala
news.title: ✺ Sillet 1.1.4
news.description: Sillet 1.1.4 is here. Bitcoin Cash, XRP, TON, Sui and Cosmos (ATOM) join the networks. Stuck payment? You can now speed it up by paying a little more fee, cancel it on EVM networks, or retry one that failed, and Sillet warns you when a fee looks too high. Android gets widgets for Market, quick actions and your address as a QR code, Lite mode for better performance at android, and everything is faster and lighter. The Horror theme makes way for a new Litecoin theme, flags now load instantly and Receive search matches Market. We also hardened security: updates only install when you press Install, automatic updates are off by default, you can turn off news, predictions and update checks, swaps show where your funds go before you confirm, and your secret phrase is wiped from memory when you lock the wallet. Download the new version with the attached link
